title: Why we love lists
text: {{1}} you are packing for a trip or planning a wedding, there is something deeply satisfying about writing a list. Psychologists believe lists reduce anxiety {{2}} giving us a sense of control. A written list also frees {{3}} mental space: once a task is on paper, the brain no longer needs {{4}} hold on to it. Some people take list-making {{5}} extreme, noting down every minor chore. Interestingly, research suggests that people {{6}} write lists complete more tasks, but only {{7}} the lists are realistic. If not, the list becomes a source {{8}} guilt rather than comfort.
